verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only an LLM-oriented API reference text with endpoint descriptions. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The separate sandbox environment and the CLI/MCP tooling are adjacent features, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
